merchant/30840.htm.text: Trader Lorenzo: At one time there were discussions regarding opening the border, but now it is even more tightly sealed than before... My younger brother went to Elmore to start a business... I'm afraid I may never see him again!

links.text: See the lord and get the tax rate information

merchant/30840-pk.htm.text: Trader Lorenzo: I regret that we will be unable to do business with you. You will likely hear this in other stores around here as well. If you have anything to sell you should go to Floran Village or Hardin's Academy, or perhaps you can find someone who will do a direct exchange with you...

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
